description: “Proximal control of bleeding, volume replacement, prevent hypothermia, economy of motion.”I had a habit of mumbling these principles to myself as I did the hardest part of an incoming casualty… waiting. I was standing in the receiving area of the Forward Surgical Team structure at Camp Dahlke, Afghanistan.
